description: Search and filter Polish KRS companies (spółki). Compabase also holds the full CEIDG/JDG register; this tool does not browse JDG — those without a public contact email are hidden because of RODO. Default `fields=summary` returns a compact row (name, NIP, KRS, location, PKD, latest financials, email/phone/website) — small enough for MCP clients. `fields=contacts_only` is name/NIP/KRS/city/email/phone/website only. `fields=full` returns every company_search column plus contacts and may exceed client size limits. Use for rankings, sector filters, city/county/region browsing, name search, or NIP/KRS lookup. When a PKD is mostly JDG, a sparse result includes a `hint` (full CEIDG is in the database; listing is RODO-gated). Do not call export_companies just to get a handful of emails or phones.

all_pkd.description: Match any PKD code in the company's activity list (not just primary).

city.description: City name — KRS records use uppercase, e.g. 'WARSZAWA', 'POZNAŃ'.

currency.description: Currency for monetary filters. Default: pln.

estimated_value_max.description: Maximum Ohlson estimated equity value in PLN.

estimated_value_min.description: Minimum Ohlson estimated equity value in PLN.

fields.description: Response size. Default summary (name, NIP, KRS, location, PKD, latest financials, email/phone/website). contacts_only: name, NIP, KRS, city, email, phone, website. full: every company_search column plus contacts — often too large for MCP clients.

has_email.description: true = only companies with email on record. Matching rows include contacts.email. Omit otherwise.

has_website.description: true = only companies with website on record. Matching rows include contacts.website. Omit otherwise.

is_active.description: true = active only, false = closed only. Omit for all.

krs.description: KRS registry number (10 digits, zero-padded, e.g. '0000028860').

legal_form.description: Legal form fragment, e.g. 'spółka z o.o.' or 'akcyjna'.

name.description: Company name fragment (case-insensitive). Matches display name and full KRS name; legal-form suffixes like 'sp. z o.o.' are ignored.

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits, no dashes).

pkd.description: Primary PKD code prefix, e.g. '46.90.Z' or '46'.

profit_operating_max.description: Maximum operating profit (PLN). Omit if unused.

profit_operating_min.description: Minimum operating profit (PLN). Negative allowed. Omit if unused.

registration_date_min.description: Earliest KRS registration date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). For newly registered companies use today's date for both registration_date_min and registration_date_max.

sort_by.description: Sort field (default: revenue_total). registration_date + sort_dir=desc lists the newest registrations first. revenue_growth_pct + sort_dir=desc lists the fastest-growing companies (y/y revenue growth from KRS financial statements; combine with revenue_min to skip small companies).

year.description: Filter to companies whose latest financial_period_to falls within this calendar year (e.g. 2024). Use only for sector/ranking browse — omit when looking up a company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name: search_companies
title: Search Polish Companies
